g.text: POST /api/oslfs/create/prepare + /send — record a new OSLF document on chain
Phase 1 — prepare (deploys nothing; identities minted here)
The document identity (UUIDv4 id) and its first
version (UUIDv7) exist from prepare onward, but
the record exists on chain only after the send's
deploy finalizes. An abandoned prepare leaves
